Thanks for the detailed review. I'll update this PR to include:

1. A working `generate_changelog.py` script that parses git history since the last tag
2. Auto-categorization logic mapping commits to Added/Fixed/Changed/Removed sections based on conventional commit prefixes
3. A README with 3-step setup instructions
4. Sample output generated from a real repository in the PR description

Will push the updated implementation shortly.
risks: Static CHANGELOG.md alone does not meet acceptance criteria — must be replaced or supplemented with functional generator
Auto-categorization logic must handle edge cases (merge commits, non-conventional messages)
Sample output must be verifiable against a real repo's git history
PR may need force-push if CHANGELOG.md is replaced rather than augmented
